children: Riley Exploration Permian is raising its quarterly dividend by 5% to 42 cents a share, up from 40 cents.
The new payout, equal to $1.68 a year, represents a 3.6% annual yield based on the company's Wednesday closing price of $46.43.
The dividend will be paid on Nov. 11 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 28.
